title: GTV: Generating Tabular Data via Vertical Federated Learning
summary: GTV is a vertical-federated-learning framework that trains a GAN across a server and multiple clients holding disjoint feature partitions (demonstrated on a Loan dataset) to jointly produce synthetic tabular data without sharing raw records. It vendors and rearchitects CTGAN's Discriminator, Residual, and Generator modules into a distributed client/server training loop.
